response.query: For qualitative rapid studies, what sampling frame and estimated sample sizes per respondent type (adolescents, mothers‑in‑law, teachers, health workers) will we use, and what concrete safety/referral procedures will be in place?
response.answer: For qualitative rapid studies, use purposive sampling with 10-20 participants per respondent type. Safety/referral procedures include trained facilitators and follow-up support.
